questions.q: Why do so many questions about why things happen come down to human choices?
questions.answer: Choices shape so much of life, from quick decisions to hard ones. God gave people the real ability to choose, so a lot of what happens comes from what we decide.

questions.q: Why might the fact that you can choose at all point to a God who exists?
questions.answer: If we were only physical stuff, like water taking the shape of a glass, we couldn't truly choose. Real choices make sense if a personal God made us in His image.

questions.q: When is it hard to be honest in your group, and what would make it safer?
questions.answer: One example: "It's hard when I disagree and worry how people will react. Knowing questions are welcome and no one will put me down would make it safer."
